summary: 16.16 fixed-point multiply with rounding: multiplies two 32-bit integer operands as a signed 64-bit product, adds the half-unit rounding constant 0x8000, then shifts the sum right by 16 to land back on the fixed-point scale.

operations.description: Form the signed 64-bit product of the two 32-bit operands: a2 * (__int64)a1.
Add the rounding offset 0x8000 (half of 2^16) to the 64-bit product.
Shift the sum right by 16 bits, treating the intermediate as an unsigned 64-bit value per the raw source cast, to recover the fixed-point result.
